title: A learner has gone quiet
intro: Practise a supportive conversation without pretending to diagnose another person. Follow several layers of choices and consequences.

nodes.title: The situation
nodes.body: A learner who usually contributes has missed two activities. You do not know why. You have a chance to offer support.

nodes.title: Open the conversation
nodes.body: How do you make first contact?

choices.label: Ask for an explanation in the group

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 1
nodes.body: The learner can choose whether and how to respond. You explain what support is available without making assumptions.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 1
nodes.body: The learner receives attention they did not request. You will need to move the conversation to a private channel and acknowledge that choice.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 1
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Listen before planning
nodes.body: The learner says the workload feels difficult. What next?

choices.label: Ask which part is hardest to access

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 2
nodes.body: They describe a specific barrier. You can discuss adjustments to the activity rather than guessing at the cause.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 2
nodes.body: Your suggestion may help, but you have not checked the barrier. You pause and ask whether it fits their situation.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 2
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

choices.label: Agree one achievable step and a check-in

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 3
nodes.body: The learner chooses a manageable action. You both know when to check whether the arrangement helped.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 3
nodes.body: There is room for flexibility, but no shared next action. You offer to agree a smaller, clearer step when the learner is ready.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 3
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Your route, your explanation
nodes.body: Reflect on privacy, listening and learner agency. This is a practice conversation, not clinical advice or a substitute for your organisation's support procedures.
nodes.prompt: What would you keep or change next time?
